observations: A black and yellow gasoline generator is the primary subject.
The brand 'COROLLA' and model 'CL7800E2R' are printed on the front panel.
The control panel includes a key-start ignition, a digital display (voltmeter), a circuit breaker, and two AC outlets.
A 12V battery (model LY-12-QFD-7) is visible, connected for the electric start system.
The unit is sitting on cardboard, stacked above an 'ELEPAQ SV22000E' generator.
A watermark for 'C MAX ELECTRONICS' is visible across the center of the image.
The generator appears to be in a retail or warehouse environment.

risks.risk: The generator may not start or may fail to produce electricity under load.

risks.risk: The actual power capacity may be lower than the claimed 4.5kVA.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification plate on the side of the alternator.
